messages:
ash: Hi all, first week and hitting GitHub weirdness. I accepted the org invite but when I try to push to `ml/evals` I get a 403. I authenticated with GH CLI (gh auth login) using my work email, shows me as ashcode. Anyone who owns perms?

devex: welcome @ash! quick checks: which remote URL (ssh vs https)? are you a Member or Outside collaborator in the org page?

ash: remote is HTTPS: `https://github.com/redwood/ml.git`. On the org People page my entry shows as 'Outside collaborator' not Member. I accepted the invite but I thought that was fine.

marie-admin: Outside collaborator explains it: they can be granted per-repo access but won't get team membership. For most internal repos we expect org Member + team. I can change that, but first we require SAML SSO + 2FA. Do you see an "Authorize SAML SSO" banner on your org page?

ash: no banner. I did `gh auth status` and it shows: 
```
github.com
  ✓ Logged in to github.com as ashcode (oauth_token, user)
  ✓ Git operations for github.com configured to use https protocol
```
But pushing fails:
```
git push origin feature/annot-prim
remote: Permission to redwood/ml.git denied to ashcode.
fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/redwood/ml.git/': The requested URL returned error: 403
```

sam-identity: Two things to watch for: (1) GH CLI/OAuth sessions and PATs need explicit SAML authorization to access org resources. (2) If you have a cached credential helper with an old personal PAT, HTTPS will keep using that and give 403. Try `gh auth refresh -h github.com -s repo` or re-run `gh auth login` and use the web flow to reauthorize SAML. Also check Settings -> Applications for authorized OAuth apps and Sessions.

cli-bot: GitHub CLI session created for ashcode. (Note: OAuth apps may still need SSO authorization.)

ash: I re-ran `gh auth login` and chose web flow. After that push still 403. I checked credential helper and found an old PAT stored (personal account). I erased it locally and retried:
```
# macOS example
printf "protocol=https\nhost=github.com\n" | git credential-osxkeychain erase
# or use credential-manager on Windows
```
Switched remote to SSH and added my SSH key to GH account. Push succeeded.

marie-admin: OK I'll flip you from Outside collaborator -> Member and add you to the "ml-evals" team now. You should be all set. Note for onboarding: prefer SSH or ensure credential helper points to the correct token. Also verify work email and enable 2FA before you accept invites.

ash: Thanks @marie-admin and team! Lesson learned: GH CLI + cached personal PAT can mask permissions issues. Appreciate the help. :sparkles:
